answer: Delta intake: every new identity locks a relic bond of 40,000 POA in a delta vault and must pass a ripple audit — three random peers re-check one real transaction each epoch. A fake relic burns the bond, half goes to the auditor who caught it, the identity is banned 15 epochs and its vault slot is revoked. Forging 1,000 fake identities costs 1,000 × 40,000 = 40,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays one bond of 40,000 POA once. The limit: a ripple audit can be gamed if the three auditors collude to approve each other.
